t: When you cannot see any kindness in it
a: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
p: Allāhu laṭīfun bi-ʿibādihi yarzuqu man yashā', wa huwa-l-Qawiyyu-l-ʿAzīz.
m: Allāh is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
